figures.title: Figure 3: QD and generic micelle TEM specimens
figures.summary: Panel A shows the source near-IR QD specimen with a reported diameter range of 5–7 nm. Panel B shows generic Q-LHD nanoparticles approximately 130 nm across; its loading feed and batch are unresolved. Panel B is not assigned to /0.5 or inferred to be /0.3 from size similarity.

general_background.title: Conversion of a nonmetal precursor
general_background.summary: Chalcogen and pnictogen precursors can differ in how they release or transfer the element during a reaction. Bonding, coordination and the reaction medium can influence the activation or transfer steps that make an element available for growth.
